segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct StructToolbarItemGroupView: View { @State private var text = "" @State private var bold = false @State private var italic = false @State private var fontSize = 12.0 var displayFont: Font { let font = Font.system(size: CGFloat(fontSize), weight: bold == true ? .bold : .regular) return italic == true ? font.italic() : font } var body: some View { TextEditor(text: $text) .font(displayFont) .toolbar { ToolbarItemGroup { Slider( value: $fontSize, in: 8...120, minimumValueLabel: Text("A").font(.system(size: 8)), maximumValueLabel: Text("A").font(.system(size: 16)) ) { Text("Font Size (\(Int(fontSize)))") } .frame(width: 150) Toggle(isOn: $bold) { Image(systemName: "bold") } Toggle(isOn: $italic) { Image(systemName: "italic") } } } .navigationTitle("My Note") } } ```
